datasources.custom_sql:
WITH invoice_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_TABLEAU.RAW.INVOICE_CDC
), payment_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_TABLEAU.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC
), payments AS (
  SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS PAID_CENTS
  FROM payment_versions WHERE RN = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED
  GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID
), history AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO
  FROM DMA_TABLEAU.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY
)
SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID, i.CUSTOMER_ID,
       CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE,
       i.AMOUNT_CENTS, a.ADJUSTMENT_CENTS,
       COALESCE(p.PAID_CENTS, 0) AS PAID_CENTS,
       LOWER(TRIM(i.STATUS)) AS STATUS, h.SEGMENT
FROM invoice_versions i
LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN history h ON i.TENANT_ID = h.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = h.CUSTOMER_ID
  AND CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) >= CAST(h.VALID_FROM AS DATE)
  AND (CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) < CAST(h.VALID_TO AS DATE) OR h.VALID_TO IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN DMA_TABLEAU.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS a ON i.TENANT_ID = a.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = a.INVOICE_ID
WHERE i.RN = 1 AND NOT i.IS_DELETED

joins: LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID

LEFT JOIN history AS h ON i.TENANT_ID = h.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = h.CUSTOMER_ID AND CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) >= CAST(h.VALID_FROM AS DATE) AND (CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) < CAST(h.VALID_TO AS DATE) OR h.VALID_TO IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN DMA_TABLEAU.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS AS a ON i.TENANT_ID = a.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = a.INVOICE_ID
